name: Patrick Lawton
role: City Administrator, City of Germantown, TN
bio:
Patrick Lawton has been City Administrator for the City of Germantown, Tennessee, since 1989. He previously served as Assistant to the City Manager and Community Development Director for the City of Champaign, Illinois, and as an Administrative Assistant for the City of Salinas, California. He holds a Bachelor of Science (1979) and a Master of Public Administration (1981) from Indiana State University.

He was named the Tennessee Municipal League's City Manager of the Year in 1996 and the American Society for Public Administration Mid-South Chapter's Administrator of the Year in 1997, and has taught as an adjunct at the University of Memphis. He is an ICMA Credentialed Manager, serves on ICMA's Performance Management Advisory Committee, and has served on the boards of the Tennessee Center for Performance Excellence, the Germantown Performing Arts Center, and Leadership Germantown. He is a past president of the Tennessee City Managers Association and the Tennessee Personnel Management Association, and past treasurer of Mid-South ASPA.

He and his wife, Cathy, a retired special education teacher, have three children and three grandchildren.
